duplicates.notes: One public route per locale. The registry replaces only the exact predecessor with the same public slug.

ingredients.notes: Twelve edible inputs are weighed, with separate coconut-milk amounts for batter and curry. Batter oil is weighed and fully accounted for.

method.notes: The published McCormick batter ratio is halved and uses pure turmeric instead of its spice blend; Ajinomoto supports the straining and net technique. No physical cooking test was performed.

food_safety.notes: Minimum 75 °C throughout the chicken; separate raw chicken from cooked crepes. Cook egg and flour batter until set; declare wheat and egg and check the curry label.

servings_and_time.notes: Two equal portions of all cooked crepes and curry; 75 minutes estimated. No measured crepe count.

nutrition.notes: The four modeled macros are 50.27, 52.61, 28.12, 40.39 g per serving. The total spice mass bounds any omitted macro to 1 g and energy to 9 kcal per serving.

glycemic.notes: GI 49 in GK149 applies to a specific tested net crepe only. It is not a match to this new batter or the chicken curry meal.
